title: Inner Light · morning promo · 05-pulse-finger
prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 film, 35mm look, soft natural grain, natural light only. Muted palette with periwinkle and slate-blue tones, warm haze, never clinical white. One person alone, unhurried, eyes closed or turned from the lens, never smiling at camera. Camera barely moves: a slow push-in or a held frame, no whip pans. Any phone in shot is an ordinary smartphone with a dim, unreadable screen. No text, no logos, no subtitles. Close on the same woman's hands holding a smartphone face-down in her lap, one fingertip resting still over the small camera lens on the back of the phone; the lens glows a soft red through the edge of her fingertip. Her hand is completely still. Held frame, shallow depth of field.
